The Enhancement Quality is mild and the ET Volume (mL) is small relative to Total tumor volume (mL), which is also more typical of IDH-mutant tumors than classic IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. Evidence arguing toward IDH-wildtype includes substantial non-enhancing/necrotic component by Proportion Necrosis and NCR Volume (mL), extensive edema by ED Volume (mL) and Proportion of Oedema, Ependymal (ventricular) Invasion, Deep WM invasion, Multiple satellites present, and midline_shift_present, all of which indicate aggressive infiltrative behavior. On balance, the young age and cortical fronto-insular mildly enhancing phenotype outweigh the aggressive features, so the best estimate is IDH-mutant.
